text_block_list.text:
After spending some time out with Cheval Grand,
I brought her to a certain place.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... where is this...?
"Having learned from our last outing that Cheval Grand likes meat buns, I thought she would enjoy it here."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………Th-Thank... you very much.
I'm... looking forward to it...

Despite a few concerns... for now,
I stepped into the Steamed Bun Museum alongside her.
It was a unique facility where visitors could tour the factory, make their own steamed meat buns, and even enjoy various activities themed around them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing...
It's a meat bun sculpture... It's huge...
choice_data_list: Want me to take a picture of you together?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm fine...
I'll just take a picture of that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Trainer?
Huh... Y-You're taking a photo?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...W-What a wonderful smile...
Um... I-I'm taking it now, okay...?

Next was a hands-on steamed bun making session. Cheval Grand
looked at the meat bun she had made with a complicated expression.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm...
Wrapping this is hard...
choice_data_list: You're even better at it than I am!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's not true at all.
You've done so much more, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Then shall we swap once we finish?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... N-No, it's fine...
I-I'll eat my own food, so...
choice_data_list: I want to try what Cheval made!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
............
...A-Are you really sure you want mine...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...H-How is it?
Um, if it's hard to eat, I can swap it out right now—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um.
Is that... really true......?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I'm sure.
This one will taste better, I think..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
An AR steamed bun experience?
...Ah, amazing... Through the camera,
Trainer looks just like a steamed bun...

I stepped to the rhythm. Thinking it might be amusing,
I broke into a dance entirely unbecoming of a meat bun.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Train—... pfft!
Wait... wh-what are you doing...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Heh, hehe. M-Meat buns don't dance that nimbly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I guess that covers... everything?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Um, maybe you couldn't fully enjoy yourself since you were stuck with me, but...
choice_data_list: No, I had plenty of fun!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh...!?
Y-You really had fun... being with me...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(......Ah. But that's right...
Trainer really has always been—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Pfft.
...He-heheh...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm sorry.
I just remembered the meat bun dance..."
choice_data_list: Above all, I'm glad you had fun!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I... um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I never really know what to say at times like this..."
choice_data_list: Wanna check out the places we haven't seen yet?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes.

After buying a drink and returning to the eat-in area,
I found Cheval Grand nodding off.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*...
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should just let her sleep like this.)
It's time to head home, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*Zzz*... *zzz*...
*Nom, nom*...

Is she dreaming about food? I gently pulled her mouth
away from where she was chewing on her uniform sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...
...*snooze* *snooze*...
choice_data_list: Have you gotten a little more used to things, I wonder?

text_block_list.text: Watching Cheval Grand sleeping like a baby, thoughts like that crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's go home!
I'm so sorry for dozing off...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
It's nothing, really, absolutely nothing!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It's... nothing...
